messages.subject: Re: ggplot2: Displaying equation of the line on the plot
parts:
Hi,

You might want to try package ggpmisc. Have a look at the vignette for examples.
(I am biased, I am the author, but I think it provides the easiest way for displaying an equation in a ggplot).

Pedro.
